set.body: Implement the smallest coherent GeneralizedLeastSquares path: accept or estimate AR(1), whiten design/response per run, then reuse OLS. Acceptance: GLS runs through FitPlanExecutor, reports AR diagnostics, rejects unsupported AR configs explicitly, and passes JVM and Scala.js numeric tests against a controlled autocorrelated fixture.
set.title: Slice 9: AR(1)/GLS first executable engine
